name: @feitio/react
description: Feitio's components for React: the same HTML as the Astro components, with the behaviors wired by hooks.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && NODE_ENV=production bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --external react --external react/jsx-runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/fix-declarations.ts
